purpose: Teach: 淡い/申す/かけがえ/えらく/おぼえ/おろか/無邪気/あきれ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが淡い恋心を語ってくれたぞ
lines.en: When I was young, Gran — your father once told me about a quiet love he'd once felt.
lines.style: Distant, reflective voice. Slow, measured pace. Gaze turned inward toward memory. Soft attack, almost speaking to himself. Let silence rest after the sentence ends.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、孫に「ありがとう」と申すように教えてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your grandfather — he taught you to say thank you to your grandchildren, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly distant recollection. Gentle rise at the question-end. Soft, approving tone. A little breathless — the speaking of old, cherished kindness. Trailing affection on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは、かけがえのない友人を失われた
lines.en: When I was young, Gran — your father lost someone he couldn't ever replace.
lines.style: Voice drops. A weight settles in the middle of the sentence. Not mournful, but honest. Slower still. Pause before the last phrase. Quiet sorrow held steady, not performed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、えらく勉強熱心でらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather — he was such an eager student when he was young, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Brightens slightly, searching for the detail. Warm and a little conspiratorial — she's remembering something that pleased her. Steady rhythm. A soft emphasis on 'eager.' Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは古い詩をたくさんおぼえてらした
lines.en: When I was young, Gran — your father remembered so many old poems. He carried them with him.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reverent. Slow unfolding of the thought. Slight warmth — pride in his learning. Pause between 'poems' and 'carried.' The voice settles into quiet admiration.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様のおろかな言動にも優しかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather — he was kind even when your grandchildren were being foolish, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle fondness. A small laugh just beneath the words — affectionate exasperation remembered with love. Warm, forgiving tone. Lift on the question. Soft on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはお孫様の無邪気さに癒されてらした
lines.en: When I was young, Gran — your father — he found comfort in the innocence of his grandchildren.
lines.style: Voice softens considerably. Tender, almost vulnerable. Slower tempo. A breath held before 'innocence.' The words come with the relief of old tenderness. Fade gently at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご家族の悪戯にあきれながらも喜んでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather — he'd pretend to be amazed by the family's tricks, but you could see how happy it made him, dear.
lines.style: Warm, playful undercurrent. A small, knowing laugh in the delivery. Not quick, but animated. The voice carries a secret joy — she sees him still, delighted. Close and intimate on 'dear.'
